notes.title: Early Playtest
notes.content:
Welcome to the EARLY playtest build of MANTRA. The current build(s) are not representative of the final product we wish to create. If you were granted early access to our alpha demo, we would greatly appreciate any feedback or bugs you may encounter either on our Steam Discussion page or over in our discord server. As of this moment, we do not have a set cycle in which we'd like to send updated builds, but make sure to stay tuned as we'll announce when we have new updates!
